summary: Mobix Labs filed an 8-K reporting amendments to a convertible note facility with Leviston Resources, increasing principal from $3M to $4M and granting a $4M delayed-draw right. The note was fully converted into common stock and resold under an effective S-1; no material ownership threshold was exceeded. This is a routine debt-to-equity conversion and at-the-market resale, not a special situation event. The filing reflects standard financing mechanics without a transformative corporate action.
